name: trust_boundary
title: Where application encryption ends
summary: YUME protection ends at yumed. Application HTTPS can continue through it to the origin. An outside observer still sees the tunnel endpoint and encrypted sizes and timing.

nodes.title: Application HTTPS
nodes.note: The application authenticates and encrypts to its own destination independently of YUME.

nodes.title: yume or libyume
nodes.note: Seals the application's bytes into YTP records inside TLS to yumed. It does not replace the application's TLS.

nodes.title: yumed
nodes.note: Reads identities and destinations and removes YUME protection. HTTPS content remains encrypted, while plain application content is readable.

nodes.title: Origin
nodes.note: Authenticates the application connection and decrypts its HTTPS content. It sees the exit server's address.

nodes.title: Path observer
nodes.note: Observes the client-to-server connection. TLS hides payloads, but ClientHello, site name, endpoint IP and traffic geometry remain visible.
